# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Extracted the remaining hardcoded condition-support knobs into named shrimp runtime/species parameters and tightened the weak reproduction regressions. `update_condition()` now uses `condition_do_reference_mg_l`, `condition_nh3_sensitivity`, `condition_nitrite_sensitivity`, and `condition_hourly_stress_penalty_weight` instead of the old `6.0`, `3.0`, `0.5`, and `0.5` literals; those fields are wired through `ShrimpRuntimeParams`, defaults, invariant validation, `ShrimpPreset` lookup/validation, scenario materialization, and the shipped `neocaridina_davidi.toml`. I also hardened `test_egg_dropping_from_sudden_change()` so it only passes when real egg-drop events occur and both berried/egg counts fall, tightened `test_neglected_tank_breeding_stalls()` so it now requires no net growth or a meaningful decline from peak, and added direct unit coverage proving the new condition knobs materially change condition outcomes under the same stressors.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Audited the shrimp condition path, preset plumbing, and regression assertions to map each pending amendment to the concrete runtime, validation, and test surfaces that still needed changes.
2. [Completed] Patched the shrimp runtime/preset stack so the daily condition DO reference, NH3 sensitivity, nitrite sensitivity, and hourly stress-penalty weight are named species parameters with defaults, invariants, preset exposure, and scenario mapping.
3. [Completed] Strengthened the reproduction regressions so egg dropping now requires emitted drop events plus observable clutch loss, and neglected-tank breeding only passes when population truly stalls or declines from peak.
4. [Completed] Formatted the tree and ran focused regressions for reproduction behavior, new condition-parameter unit coverage, invariant/save-load rejection, and shrimp preset materialization.

## Validation Evidence

- Source audit confirms `update_condition()` now reads `condition_do_reference_mg_l`, `condition_nh3_sensitivity`, `condition_nitrite_sensitivity`, and `condition_hourly_stress_penalty_weight`, and the same fields are present in `ShrimpRuntimeParams`, `ShrimpPreset`, scenario mapping, and `crates/tank_data/data/shrimp/neocaridina_davidi.toml`.
- `cargo fmt --all --check` passed.
- `git diff --check -- crates/tank_core/src/types/biology.rs crates/tank_core/src/invariants.rs crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs crates/tank_data/data/shrimp/neocaridina_davidi.toml crates/tank_core/tests/reproduction_factors.rs crates/tank_core/tests/validation.rs crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs` returned clean.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test reproduction_factors -- --nocapture` passed with 17/17 tests, including the tightened egg-drop and neglected-tank assertions.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --lib test_condition_environment_reference_and_sensitivities_are_named_parameters -- --nocapture` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --lib test_condition_hourly_stress_penalty_weight_is_named_parameter -- --nocapture` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test validation step_hours_rejects_invalid_molt_mineral_parameters_before_simulation -- --nocapture` passed, covering the new invariant-rejection cases.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load malformed_current_save_with_invalid_molt_mineral_parameters_is_rejected -- --nocapture` passed, confirming malformed saves with the new condition parameters are rejected.
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios shrimp_preset_mapping_carries_stage_runtime_fields_and_legacy_split -- --nocapture` passed, confirming the new condition knobs survive preset-to-runtime materialization.

## Outstanding Risks

- Validation was targeted rather than workspace-wide; I did not rerun the full `tank_core`, `tank_harness`, or full workspace suites after these shrimp-condition and regression changes.
- `git status --short --untracked-files=all` still shows unrelated local dirtiness outside this deliverable (`.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7`, `docs/validation_scenarios.md`, and extensive `.ralph-burning/` artifacts), which I left untouched.
